newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commission Secretary General David Williamson would retire at the end of July 1997 after 10 years in this post. He said the Commission would formally open the procedure for his replacement on Tuesday afternoon. No names of potential successors have been mentioned yet, he said.
In answer to a question, Vale de Almeida said spokesman Filippo di Robilant would be available to reporters after the meeting of the Food Safety Group starting at 1500/1300 GMT.

Asked about the collapse of the proposed EU/Australia framework agreement, spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission did not abandon attempts to reach such an agreement but that they were now putting all their efforts into the prospect of a political declaration. Guilford said it was too early to judge the implications for human rights commitments.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/385: The Commission adopts revised guidelines for state aid in the maritime transport sector.
- IP/97/388: Commission opens dialogue on urban development.
- IP/97/389: Report on the social dialogue in 1996.
- IP/97/391: Work programme for the fight against fraud 1997-98.
- Commission document: Protection of the Community's financial interests.
- Commission document: Fight against fraud - Annual report 1996.
- Eurostat Statistics in focus - Distributive trades, services and transport No 1997-2: Financial services statistics.
